source_revisions.existing_action_recovery: Exact current source already handles the unmatched executable ActionEvent stale-HEAD subclass: startup scans the full immutable log, creates AgentErrorEvent with parent_id explicitly set to the unmatched ActionEvent id, and the existing cross test rewinds persisted HEAD then verifies the next active-branch/condenser manipulation remains valid.
source_revisions.remaining_user_message_class: That repair is intentionally action-specific and runs when persisted execution_status was RUNNING. A normal user MessageEvent durably written before a deferred base-state save can be stranded behind a stale non-null leaf with no unmatched-action signal. Cold _resolve_active_leaf returns a non-null persisted leaf as-is, so tail fallback does not discover the message.
source_revisions.state_transaction_boundary: LocalConversation's default callback appends through ConversationState while the state context lock is held, then records last_user_message_id for user messages. ConversationState.__exit__ flushes dirty state only when the outer save depth reaches zero, providing an exact event-file-before-base-snapshot failure injection seam.
source_revisions.lease_boundary: Agent Server claims ConversationLease and installs the lease-backed state write guard before recovery writes. The implementation candidate therefore reconciles pending HEAD markers only after that fence is active.

cases: pending user MessageEvent: marker + durable event survive a deliberately failed deferred base save; after lease takeover, recovered leaf_event_id and last_user_message_id must point to that message, repaired base state must persist it, marker must clear, and next user message must parent to it
markerless tail descendant: immutable orphan event without commit marker must not be auto-adopted after restart, protecting navigation/fork intent

implementation_candidate.claim_limit: No claim of upstream correctness: implementation and pytest patches have not been applied together, type-checked, compiled, or run in the upstream repository.

counterexamples_and_guardrails: Do not replace existing unmatched-Action recovery; it synthesizes an execution failure result that marker reconciliation alone does not provide.
Do not infer write intent from a unique newer descendant; markerless tails can represent an orphan or intentional branch history.
Do not run recovery writes before the lease generation write guard is installed.
Do not generalize LocalFileStore file-level atomicity/locking guarantees to NFS/network filesystems without backend-specific evidence.
The marker hash binds exact event bytes/content, while monotonic persistence_generation provides the history-bearing component needed to avoid content-identity ABA.
